Indian Army DG EME Group C Offline Form 2024 - Complete Details

Short Information : Directorate General of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers (DG EME) has released the notification for the recruitment of Group C posts across various Army Base Workshops and Static Workshops in India. This recruitment has been issued for 625 posts. Offline applying process for Indian Army DG EME Group C Recruitment 2024 has started from 28 December 2024 & the candidates can apply till 17 January 2025.
